AboutMe.Title: About Me
AboutMe.Paragraphs: I graduated with Honors and Excellent grades in Computer Science, having completed intensive Full Stack .NET & Angular training at the Information Technology Institute (ITI). This combination of academic excellence and practical training has given me a robust foundation in full-stack application development.

I have successfully delivered multiple projects using .NET and Angular frameworks, demonstrating my ability to transform conceptual ideas into functional, production-ready applications. My approach blends technical expertise with creative problem-solving to build effective digital solutions.

FeatureProjects.Projects.Title: Airbnb
FeatureProjects.Projects.Description: This project is a full-stack web application that replicates core features of Airbnb for both Hosts and Guests. Users can register, log in, list properties, and make bookings through an interactive and secure platform. The system includes advanced search, filtering, and a calendar to view available dates. Role-based functionality ensures a tailored experience for each user type. The project simulates real-world business logic with a focus on user experience and security.

FeatureProjects.Projects.Title: Social Media App
FeatureProjects.Projects.Description: A responsive social media platform built with Angular and styled with Bootstrap and custom CSS. The app features a mock backend powered by JSON Server, simulating RESTful API endpoints for seamless frontend development. Key functionalities include user authentication, post creation with images, real-time likes/comments, and profile management. The clean UI leverages Bootstrap's grid system and components while custom CSS ensures unique styling.

FeatureProjects.Projects.Title: ITI Examination System Database
FeatureProjects.Projects.Description: The ITI Examination System is a comprehensive database designed to manage exams, questions, student data, and instructor information. This system helps organize and streamline examination processes, including student-course enrollments, exam questions, and score tracking.
